_notes: 'matches' stays 'correspondances' (18 existing uses in student.json; one signup key aligned to it); 'plan' stays 'formule'; document review = 'vérification' everywhere (was mixed examen/relecture/vérification); consultation = 'consultation' (was mixed with 'entretien'); 'entretien blanc' kept for mock interview; managed application = 'candidature prise en charge'; visa support = 'préparation des documents de visa' (never 'préparation du visa'); 'contracted documents' = 'documents prévus au contrat'.

Gendered participles addressed to the student were rephrased épicène (Diplômé → Diplôme obtenu; Vous allez être redirigé → Nous vous redirigeons; Vous restez connecté → Votre connexion reste active; You're enrolled → Inscription confirmée; You're admitted → Votre admission est confirmée).

Staff strings (mobile:agency.*, mobile:university.*, mobile:v3.agency.*, mobile:v3.uni.*, mobile:v3.reviews.*): short, formal, no CRM words; 'first-response promise' rendered 'délai de première réponse promis'; 'counselor' = 'conseiller' (staff-facing only).

Legal consent summaries (student:register / mobile:signup CROSS_BORDER_VERIFICATION.summary, PRIVACY.summary) re-aligned to the reviewed English, which says less than the previous French (no retention period, 'password (stored encrypted)' not 'hash'); owner should confirm this matches the Korean policy text.
'{{remaining}} left to do' in mobile:student.nextAction.FINISH_APPLICATION rendered '({{remaining}} à faire)' so it reads for a number or a short phrase.
Plurals: every _one form keeps {{count}} or reads correctly without it (0 and 1 take _one); nouns kept singular in _one.
